notes:
C0806 is a marriage document listning an Ernestyna Celmer as the daughter of Krystyan and Dorota Kuhnert. Dorota Kuhnert is likely Dorota Kuhn (I2903) because the document states that both parents are dead (I2903 and I2902 both died before 1864-06-19, the date of the marriage in C0806), but her spouse's name was Woyciech Celmer (I2902) and not Krystyan, making this link somewhat uncertain, but most likely correct.

Note cross-referenced to Ernestyna Celmer (I3270), who is the bride in C0806 and is listed as the daughter of Woyciech Celmer (I2902) in this database.
